title: Add Vtrace to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Vtrace](https://vtrace-two.vercel.app) to image
- raster image to vector SVG

Fixes #12734

gist.headline: Pixels, meet paths
gist.blurb: Vtrace has landed in the garden: feed it a raster image and it grows you a tidy SVG. Some pixels have decided they would rather be geometry.
gist.summary: Added Vtrace to the Pollinations app directory, giving users a raster-image-to-vector-SVG conversion tool.
gist.impact: People can now turn bitmap artwork into scalable SVG paths through Vtrace, making pixel-bound images easier to reuse at any size.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Vtrace as a cozy retro art workstation where a small raster pixel flower enters a CRT scanner and emerges as a clean looping SVG vine. Polli, wearing a tiny artist beret, carefully guides the transformation while the monitor robot admires the newly traced paths; include a few real pixel flowers and code-plants to connect the tool to the Pollinations garden.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workshop where the cute bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings wears a tiny painter's beret and guides a pixel flower through a glowing CRT tracing machine; on the other side it becomes a clean curling SVG vine while a cute monitor-head robot watches with delighted square eyes. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel cream-lavender gradient background, code-plants and small flowers, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle pixel-font text: "RASTER → SVG", nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
